title: Password Vault Stale Entries
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar exports (`calendar:event`), email metadata (`email:metadata`), password-audit reports (`passwordmanager:audit`).
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, password-audit exports, and calendar/email feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=passwordmanager:audit
| stats sum(eval(last_updated_days>365)) as stale_items, count as total by vault
| where stale_items>0
| sort - stale_items
description: Shows how many credentials in each vault have not been touched in over a year, which often means old services or poor account hygiene.
value: Security debt is not only weak passwords; stale vault entries are a cleanup opportunity and an inventory of forgotten exposure.
implementation: Export audit metadata from your password manager; review stale entries periodically and close or rotate truly old accounts.
visualization: Table of vaults by stale credential count.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how many saved passwords are so old that they probably belong to accounts you should review or clean up.
